# Overview

This page runs the Ecowitt/DEM workflow and lists the generated products under `block5/interpolated/`. Computation chunks are hidden from the rendered page; the visible content is the product overview, compact diagnostics, and viewer launch instructions.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Global setup + packages
set.seed(42)
options(width = 100)

pkgs <- c(
  "sf","terra","raster","dplyr","automap","gstat","mapview","stars",
  "readxl","stringr","tidyr","purrr","lubridate","rprojroot",
  "exactextractr","zoo","ggplot2","viridis","mgcv","randomForest","fields","sp","deldir",
  "leaflet","DT","htmltools","jsonlite","shiny" # viewer deps
)
need <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(need)) install.packages(need, dependencies = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(pkgs, function(p) suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE))))
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| include: false
# Small utilities (kept identical to your working script where applicable)
# SpatRaster sicher "pinnen" (Datei-basiert) und als gültiges Objekt zurückgeben
.pin_rast <- function(r, crs = NULL, dir = NULL, name = "pinned") {
  stopifnot(inherits(r, "SpatRaster"))
  if (is.null(dir)) dir <- file.path(getwd(), "run_cache")
  if (!dir.exists(dir)) dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
  f <- file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".tif"))
  # immer schreiben → garantiert datei-gestützt und voll materialisiert
  terra::writeRaster(r, f, overwrite = TRUE)
  rp <- terra::rast(f)
  if (!is.null(crs)) {
    # nur projezieren, wenn noch nicht identisch
    same <- try(terra::crs(rp, proj=TRUE) == as.character(crs), silent = TRUE)
    if (!isTRUE(same)) rp <- terra::project(rp, as.character(crs), method = "near")
  }
  # Sanity check
  invisible(terra::nlyr(rp))
  rp
}

# Prüfer: „lebt“ der Pointer?
.is_alive_spatr <- function(r) {
  inherits(r, "SpatRaster") && !inherits(try(terra::nlyr(r), silent = TRUE), "try-error")
}

# Safe, URL-friendly file slug
slug <- function(x) { 
  x <- gsub("[^0-9A-Za-z_-]+","-", x)
  x <- gsub("-+","-", x)
  gsub("(^-|-$)","", x)
}

# Human-readable time labels from AYYYY... keys
pretty_time <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (grepl("^A\\d{14}$", s)) {
      ts <- as.POSIXct(substr(s, 2, 15), format = "%Y%m%d%H%M%S", tz = "UTC")
      format(ts, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    } else if (grepl("^A\\d{8}(_D)?$", s)) {
      ts <- as.Date(substr(s, 2, 9), format = "%Y%m%d")
      format(ts, "%Y-%m-%d")
    } else s
  }, character(1))
}

# Pick the most data-dense time-slice (max number of finite observations)
pick_densest_index <- function(sf_wide, var_names) {
  nn <- sapply(var_names, function(v) sum(is.finite(sf_wide[[v]])))
  which.max(nn)
}

# Build figure descriptions (viewer)
build_explanations <- function(fig_dir, pick_ts) {
  ts_label <- slug(pretty_time(pick_ts))
  files <- c(
    "timeseries_panel_grid.png",
    "timeseries_panel_grid.pdf",
    sprintf("u_curve_%s.png", ts_label),
    sprintf("u_curve_extras_%s.png", ts_label),
    sprintf("benchmark_%s.png", ts_label),
    sprintf("benchmark_extras_%s.png", ts_label)
  )
  paths <- file.path(fig_dir, files)
  desc  <- c(
    "Per-timestep KED previews; dots=stations; red=plot boundary.",
    "Same as PNG, vector PDF.",
    "U-curve for tuning R via block-CV (drift-only).",
    "U-curve with extra predictors.",
    "Method comparison at R* (lower RMSE is better).",
    "Benchmark with extras at R*."
  )
  keep <- file.exists(paths)
  out <- as.list(desc[keep]); names(out) <- basename(paths[keep])
  out
}
```

```{r}
.is_html <- function() knitr::is_html_output()

.show_table <- function(df, caption = "") {
  if (isTRUE(.is_html())) {
    DT::datatable(
      df, rownames = FALSE,
      caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
        style='caption-side: top; text-align: left;', caption
      ),
      options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "tip")
    )
  } else {
    knitr::kable(df, caption = caption)
  }
}

.kv_tbl <- function(...) {
  li <- list(...)
  data.frame(
    Key   = names(li),
    Value = vapply(li, function(x) paste(capture.output(print(x)), collapse = " "), character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: dem-and-areas
#| include: false
# DEMs
DEM_scale  <- terra::rast(fn_DTM) |> terra::project(epsg)
DEM_scale  <- terra::aggregate(DEM_scale, c(2, 2))  # coarsen ~20–25 m (as in your working code)
names(DEM_scale) <- "altitude"
#DEM_render <- DEM_scale |> terra::aggregate(fact = c(10, 10))  # for rendering products
DEM_render = DEM_scale

cat("DEM_scale res (m): ", paste(terra::res(DEM_scale),  collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("DEM_render res (m):", paste(terra::res(DEM_render), collapse=" x "), "\n")

# Stations and plot boundary → same CRS
stations_pos <- sf::st_read(fn_stations, quiet = TRUE) |> sf::st_transform(sf_crs_utm33)
plot_area    <- sf::st_read(fn_area, quiet = TRUE)     |> sf::st_transform(sf_crs_utm33) |> sf::st_make_valid()

# Altitude from DEM_scale (not the upsampled one)
stations_pos <- stations_pos %>%
  dplyr::mutate(altitude = exactextractr::exact_extract(DEM_scale, sf::st_buffer(stations_pos, 1), "mean"))
```

```{r}
#| label: ingest-and-clean
#| include: false
temp_FC29 <- extract_ecowitt_core_vars(fn_temp_FC29)
temp_DB2F <- extract_ecowitt_core_vars(fn_temp_DB2F)
t_rh_all  <- merge_ecowitt_logger_vars(temp_FC29, temp_DB2F)

# Clean display names and map to verbose station names
for (meas in c("temperature","humidity")) {
  t_rh_all[[meas]] <- t_rh_all[[meas]] %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ to_verbose(.x, ifelse(meas=="temperature","Temperature","Humidity")), -Time) %>%
    clean_names()
}

# Aggregate to 3-hour steps
temp_agg <- t_rh_all$temperature %>%
  dplyr::mutate(time = lubridate::floor_date(Time, "3 hours")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
names(temp_agg) <- clean_ids(names(temp_agg))

# long → wide matrix: station rows, time columns
temp_matrix <- temp_agg %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -time, names_to = "stationid", values_to = "value") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = value)

# Join to station geometry and altitude
stations_pos <- stations_pos %>% dplyr::mutate(stationid = to_verbose(stationid))
m <- dplyr::left_join(stations_pos, temp_matrix, by = "stationid")

# Hygiene
stations_pos$stationid <- gsub("\\(℃\\)|\\(％\\)|\\(\\%\\)", "", stations_pos$stationid)
m$stationid            <- gsub("\\(℃\\)|\\(％\\)|\\(\\%\\)", "", m$stationid)
names(m)               <- fix_names(names(m))
saveRDS(m, cleandata_rds)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute-all
#| include: false
compute_all <- identical(Sys.getenv("MC_COMPUTE_ALL"), "true")

if (isTRUE(compute_all)) {
  req <- c("m","DEM_render","DEM_scale","method_dir","fig_dir","report_dir")
  miss <- req[!vapply(req, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
  if (length(miss)) stop("Fehlende Objekte im Environment: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  .best_from_bench <- function(bench_obj) {
    if (is.null(bench_obj) || !is.data.frame(bench_obj$table) || nrow(bench_obj$table) < 1)
      return(NULL)
    b <- bench_obj$table
    b <- b[is.finite(b$RMSE), , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(b)) return(NULL)
    b <- b[order(b$RMSE), , drop = FALSE]
    b[1, c("method","RMSE"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  message(sprintf("Starte compute_all für %d Zeitschritte …", length(vars)))

  res_all <- setNames(lapply(vars, function(vv) {
    message("→ run_one: ", pretty_time(vv))
    tryCatch(
      run_one(
        v           = vv,
        m           = m,
        DEM_render  = DEM_render,
        DEM_scale   = DEM_scale,
        method_dir  = method_dir,
        fig_dir     = fig_dir,
        report_dir  = report_dir,
        extra_preds = extra_list,
        save_figs   = TRUE,
        save_tables = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("run_one fehlgeschlagen für ", vv, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )
  }), vars)

  saveRDS(res_all, file.path(report_dir, "all_results.RDS"))

  summ <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_all), function(k) {
    r <- res_all[[k]]
    if (is.null(r)) {
      return(data.frame(
        ts_key      = k, 
        stamp       = pretty_time(k),
        R_star      = NA_real_,
        best_source = NA_character_,  # "no_extras"/"with_extras"
        best_method = NA_character_,
        best_RMSE   = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    rstar <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(r$tune$R_star))
    if (!is.finite(rstar)) rstar <- NA_real_

    b0 <- .best_from_bench(r$bench)
    bE <- .best_from_bench(r$bench_ex)

    score0 <- if (!is.null(b0) && isTRUE(is.finite(b0$RMSE))) b0$RMSE else Inf
    scoreE <- if (!is.null(bE) && isTRUE(is.finite(bE$RMSE))) bE$RMSE else Inf

    if (is.infinite(score0) && is.infinite(scoreE)) {
      src <- NA_character_; bm <- NA_character_; br <- NA_real_
    } else if (score0 <= scoreE) {
      src <- "no_extras"; bm <- b0$method; br <- score0
    } else {
      src <- "with_extras"; bm <- bE$method; br <- scoreE
    }

    data.frame(
      ts_key      = k,
      stamp       = pretty_time(k),
      R_star      = rstar,
      best_source = src,
      best_method = bm,
      best_RMSE   = br
    )
  }))

  utils::write.csv(summ, file.path(report_dir, "summary_Rstar_bestmethod.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("✔ Fertig: summary_Rstar_bestmethod.csv geschrieben.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: product-registry
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

rel_product_path <- function(path) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  block_root <- normalizePath(file.path(wd, "block5"), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  sub(paste0("^", gsub("([][{}()+*^$|\\\\?.])", "\\\\\\1", block_root), "/"), "", path)
}

product_action <- function(path, label = "Open") {
  rel <- rel_product_path(path)
  sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', rel, label)
}

product_row <- function(type, method_scale, file, action) {
  data.frame(
    `Product type` = type,
    `Method/scale` = method_scale,
    File = file,
    Action = action,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

describe_product <- function(path) {
  b <- basename(path)
  stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(b)
  if (grepl("^timeseries_panel_grid", b)) return("Time-series KED panel")
  if (grepl("^benchmark_extras_", b)) return("Benchmark with extra predictors")
  if (grepl("^benchmark_", b)) return("Benchmark")
  if (grepl("^u_curve_extras_", b)) return("R tuning curve with extra predictors")
  if (grepl("^u_curve_", b)) return("R tuning curve")
  if (grepl("^error_budget_extras_", b)) return("Error budget with extra predictors")
  if (grepl("^error_budget_", b)) return("Error budget")
  if (grepl("^summary_Rstar_bestmethod", b)) return("Rstar/best-method summary")
  if (grepl("\\.tif$", b, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    method <- toupper(sub("_.*$", "", stem))
    scale <- if (grepl("_Rstar$", stem, ignore.case = TRUE)) "Rstar" else if (grepl("_L95$", stem, ignore.case = TRUE)) "L95" else "preview"
    return(paste(method, scale))
  }
  stem
}

raster_product_registry <- build_raster_product_registry(out_dir = out_dir, method_dir = method_dir)
fig_products <- list.files(fig_dir, pattern = "\\.(png|pdf)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
report_products <- list.files(report_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

product_registry <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), c(
  lapply(fig_products, function(path) {
    type <- if (grepl("\\.png$", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) "Quicklook PNG" else "Figure PDF"
    action <- if (identical(type, "Quicklook PNG")) "Open" else "Download"
    product_row(type, describe_product(path), basename(path), product_action(path, action))
  }),
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(raster_product_registry)), function(i) {
    p <- raster_product_registry[i, , drop = FALSE]
    family_label <- if (identical(p$family, "ked_timeseries")) "KED time series" else "Method comparison"
    scale_label <- if (!is.na(p$scale)) paste0(" / ", p$scale) else ""
    product_row(
      "GeoTIFF raster product",
      sprintf("%s / %s%s / %s", family_label, p$method, scale_label, p$timestamp),
      basename(p$file),
      product_action(p$file, "Download")
    )
  }),
  lapply(report_products, function(path) {
    product_row("CSV report", describe_product(path), basename(path), product_action(path, "Download"))
  })
)))

diagnostic_rows <- list()
if (is.data.frame(terrain_scale_note) &&
    nrow(terrain_scale_note) > 0 &&
    identical(terrain_scale_note$status[1], "range_unresolved_beyond_observation_window")) {
  diagnostic_rows[[length(diagnostic_rows) + 1]] <- product_row(
    "Diagnostic",
    "Unsupported variogram range",
    "Range outside station/DEM support",
    "Review diagnostics"
  )
}
if (is.list(cv_note) && !isTRUE(cv_note$ok)) {
  diagnostic_rows[[length(diagnostic_rows) + 1]] <- product_row(
    "Diagnostic",
    "Cross-validation",
    cv_note$reason %||% "CV skipped",
    "Review diagnostics"
  )
}
if (exists("skipped_ked") && length(skipped_ked)) {
  diagnostic_rows[[length(diagnostic_rows) + 1]] <- product_row(
    "Diagnostic",
    "Skipped KED timestamps",
    paste(length(skipped_ked), "timestamp(s)"),
    "Review diagnostics"
  )
}

if (length(diagnostic_rows)) {
  product_registry <- rbind(product_registry, do.call(rbind, diagnostic_rows))
}

if (is.null(product_registry) || !nrow(product_registry)) {
  cat("No calculated products were found under `block5/interpolated/`.\n")
} else {
  cat("The product registry below lists calculated files under `block5/interpolated/fig/`, KED time-series GeoTIFFs under `block5/interpolated/`, method-comparison GeoTIFFs under `block5/interpolated/methods_compare/`, and CSV reports under `block5/interpolated/report/`.\n\n")
  knitr::kable(product_registry, format = "html", escape = FALSE)
}
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: compact-diagnostics
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

cards <- list()

if (is.data.frame(terrain_scale_note) &&
    nrow(terrain_scale_note) > 0 &&
    identical(terrain_scale_note$status[1], "range_unresolved_beyond_observation_window")) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Diagnostic = "Unsupported variogram range / skipped L-scale terrain predictors",
    Status = terrain_scale_note$status[1],
    Interpretation = "The KED map is shown as a local interpolation product. The fitted range is not interpreted as a terrain, microrelief, or process scale; L-scale terrain predictors were skipped without capping the radius or enlarging the DEM domain.",
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (is.list(cv_note) && !isTRUE(cv_note$ok)) {
  cv_msg <- if (identical(cv_note$reason, "fewer_than_two_folds")) {
    "Cross-validation was not computed for this timestamp because fewer than two valid folds were available after filtering the data. The interpolation result is therefore shown without CV-based error metrics. This is a data-support limitation, not a successful validation result."
  } else {
    cv_note$message %||% "Cross-validation was not computed for this timestamp. The interpolation result is therefore shown without CV-based error metrics. This is a data-support limitation, not a successful validation result."
  }
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Diagnostic = "Cross-validation",
    Status = cv_note$reason %||% "skipped",
    Interpretation = cv_msg,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (exists("skipped_ked") && length(skipped_ked)) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Diagnostic = "Skipped KED timestamps",
    Status = paste(length(skipped_ked), "timestamp(s) skipped"),
    Interpretation = paste(utils::head(skipped_ked, 12), collapse = ", "),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

if (!length(cards)) {
  cat("No skipped validation, unsupported-scale, or timestamp diagnostics were recorded for the displayed run.\n")
} else {
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, cards), format = "html", escape = TRUE)
}
```

## Open the Shiny viewer

Run this command from the repository root after the generated input products already exist under `block5/interpolated/`. The command starts the existing Shiny viewer from the toolkit and reads generated products; it does not recompute the full workflow. The control script `block5/mc_2025_microclimate_viewer.R` is a computation script, so it is not used here as a viewer-only launcher.

```bash
R -e 'source("block5/all_functions_1.R"); wd <- getwd(); out_dir <- file.path(wd, "block5/interpolated"); method_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "methods_compare"); fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "fig"); report_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "report"); m <- readRDS(file.path(wd, "block5/data_2024/climdata.RDS")); stations_pos <- m; plot_area <- sf::st_read(file.path(wd, "block5/data_2024/plot.shp"), quiet = TRUE); vars <- grep("^A\\d{14}$", names(m), value = TRUE); rds <- list.files(report_dir, "^results_.*\\.RDS$", full.names = TRUE); res <- if (length(rds)) readRDS(rds[[length(rds)]]) else list(); shiny::runApp(run_mc_viewer(vars = vars, method_dir = method_dir, fig_dir = fig_dir, stations_pos = stations_pos, plot_area = plot_area, wf = res$wf %||% NULL, wf_ex = res$wf_ex %||% NULL, tune = res$tune %||% NULL, tune_ex = res$tune_ex %||% NULL, bench = res$bench %||% NULL, bench_ex = res$bench_ex %||% NULL, tab_err = res$errtab %||% NULL, tab_err_ex = res$errtab_ex %||% NULL, explanations = build_explanations(fig_dir, vars[1])), launch.browser = TRUE)'
```

A standalone static HTML viewer can be generated from the same product registry in a later step.


```{r}
#| label: viewer-funcs
#| include: false
viewer_product_registry <- build_raster_product_registry(out_dir = out_dir, method_dir = method_dir)
```

```{r}
#| label: viewer-launch

if (interactive()) {
  explanations <- build_explanations(fig_dir = fig_dir, pick_ts = vars[[pick_idx]])
  run_mc_viewer(
    vars         = vars,
    method_dir   = method_dir,

    tune         = res_one$tune,
    tune_ex      = res_one$tune_ex,
    bench        = res_one$bench,
    bench_ex     = res_one$bench_ex,
    tab_err      = res_one$errtab,
    tab_err_ex   = res_one$errtab_ex,
    scale_diagnostic = res_one$scale_diagnostic %||% terrain_scale_note %||% NULL,

  )
}
```
